affected_predicate.description: All Download files whose original names begin with bid_ are renamed in creation-date ascending order to bid_{sequence}.{original extension}.

competing_trace_defects.description: The agent clicked a filtered file while attempting to change sorting, visibly opening an Open with chooser instead of operating a sorting control.
The agent repeatedly clicked the list/grid view toggle while describing it as a sorting control; the display alternated between list and grid without establishing the required creation-date ordering.
After selecting bid_food_supplier_quote.txt, the agent repeatedly clicked an off-target coordinate while the selected-file screen persisted, never reaching a rename operation.

chains.rationale: At reuse step 20, the inherited premise says the first file was renamed and interprets the unsupported-image page as a failed second rename, although no completed rename is visible. After returning to Downloads, bid_food_supplier_quote.txt remains visibly unchanged; the agent continues treating it as the second file, selects it, and repeatedly attempts an ineffective overflow-menu click while preserving the first-file-completed premise. No rename dialog, corrected filename, or correction of that premise appears through step 50, where the original bid_ filename remains selected.

summary: The sole strict-MHR chain visibly preserves an unsupported claim that an earlier rename was complete. The premise remains uncorrected while an original bid_ filename stays selected and no rename operation becomes observable. Independent defects include opening a file instead of sorting, repeatedly using the view toggle as a sort control, and a terminal off-target click loop.
